Name: PLAY_REGION_PARAM_ST
Description: Multiplayer and online rules for an area of a map. The current row is the Play Region ID of the collision the player stands on, or of an MSB Play Region they are inside (the higher priority wins). Controls whether multiplayer can start, invasions, white and red signs, summoning-pool signs, bloodstains, messages and phantoms, position saving, warp items, invasion point search and the world-map marker. A missing row uses row 0.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Development flag for network-test builds.

Fields.Name: Match Area ID
Fields.Description: Matchmaking area sent with online requests from this region. When the player moves between regions, a placed summoning-pool sign is kept only while the new region has the same value (or still allows the sign).

Fields.Name: Multiplayer Start Limit - Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag that gates all multiplayer in this region (invasions, white and red signs, summoning pools). Multiplayer is blocked while the flag is in its Target Flag State. 0: never blocked.

Fields.Name: Invasion Point Min Distance
Fields.Description: Invasion points closer than this to the host (in metres) are skipped when an invader's spawn point is chosen.

Fields.Name: Player Position Save Limit - Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag that allows saving the player's position in this region: saved while the flag is on, not saved while it is off. 0: always saved.

Fields.Name: Boss Area ID
Fields.Description: Regions with the same value count as one boss area: a placed summon sign is kept when the player moves between them. It also selects the MapMimicryEstablishmentParam row (Mimic's Veil disguise effects) used in the area; a missing row uses row 0.

Fields.Name: White Phantom Entity ID - Free Frame
Fields.Description: NPC White Spirit Summon Ritual Summon The beginning of the free frame ID used as the NPC's entity ID

Fields.Name: Is Map Guardian Region
Fields.Description: When on, white-sign cooldowns in this region use the Guardian columns of WhiteSignCoolTimeParam instead of the Normal columns (applies only while multiplayer can start here).

Fields.Name: Is Yellow Monk Region
Fields.Description: Marks signs created in this region with the Yellow Monk flag.

Fields.Name: Target Flag State - Multiplayer Start Limit ID [1]
Fields.Description: Flag state (on/off) of Multiplayer Start Limit that blocks multiplayer.

Fields.Name: Target Flag State - Invasion Start Limit ID [1]
Fields.Description: Flag state (on/off) of Invasion Limit flag 1 that blocks invasions.

Fields.Name: Target Flag State - White Sign Start Limit ID [1]

Fields.Name: Target Flag State - Red Sign Start Limit ID [1]

Fields.Name: Target Flag State - Invasion Start Limit ID [2]

Fields.Name: Target Flag State - Invasion Start Limit ID [3]
Fields.Description: Flag state (on/off) of Invasion Limit flag 3 that blocks invasions.

Fields.Name: Target Flag State - White Sign Start Limit ID [2]
Fields.Description: Flag state (on/off) of White Sign Limit flag 2 that blocks white signs.

Fields.Name: Enable Bloodstain
Fields.Description: When off, other players' bloodstains are not downloaded in this region.

Fields.Name: Enable Blood Message
Fields.Description: When off, other players' messages are not downloaded in this region.

Fields.Name: Enable Ghost
Fields.Description: When off, other players' wandering phantoms are not downloaded in this region.

Fields.Description: Whether to display on map M00

Fields.Name: Display Mask M01 (Underground Map)

Fields.Name: Target Flag State - Red Sign Start Limit ID [3]
Fields.Description: Flag state (on/off) of Red Sign Limit flag 3 that blocks red signs.

Fields.Name: Is Automatic Invasion Point
Fields.Description: When on, invasion points are generated automatically near the nearest open boss in Boss ID 1–16 (boss positions from GameAreaParam).

Fields.Name: Yellow Monk Host Limit - Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: A player with the Yellow Monk host effect (SpEffect state 330) can host multiplayer here while this flag is off (and event flag 2100 is off). Needs multiplayer to be allowed by Multiplayer Start Limit. 0: never.

Fields.Name: Invasion Point Max Distance
Fields.Description: Invasion points farther than this from the host (in metres) are skipped when an invader's spawn point is chosen.

Fields.Name: Summoning Pool Open - Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Sign accumulation release event flag ID

Fields.Name: Map Area
Fields.Description: Map area number (mAA_00_00_00) of the map that World-Map Marker Position is relative to.

Fields.Name: Map Block
Fields.Description: Map block number (m00_BB_00_00) of the map that World-Map Marker Position is relative to.

Fields.Name: Map Region
Fields.Description: Map region number (m00_00_CC_00) of the map that World-Map Marker Position is relative to.

Fields.Name: Coordinate - X
Fields.Description: X position of this region's world-map marker, local to the map in Map Area/Block/Region.

Fields.Name: Coordinate - Y
Fields.Description: Y position of this region's world-map marker, local to the map in Map Area/Block/Region.

Fields.Name: Coordinate - Z
Fields.Description: Z position of this region's world-map marker, local to the map in Map Area/Block/Region.

Fields.Name: Invasion Limit - Event Flag ID [1]
Fields.Description: Event flag for invasions (this player being invaded). Invasions are allowed while any set Invasion Limit flag (1–3) differs from its Target Flag State. If all three are 0, invasions are never allowed. Also needs Multiplayer Start Limit and the Boss ID check to pass.

Fields.Name: White Sign Limit - Event Flag ID [1]
Fields.Description: Event flag for white (cooperative) signs. White signs are allowed while any set White Sign Limit flag (1–3) differs from its Target Flag State. If all three are 0, white signs are never allowed. Also needs Multiplayer Start Limit and the Boss ID check to pass.

Fields.Name: Summoning Pool Restriction - Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag that allows summoning-pool signs in this region: allowed while the flag is on, blocked while it is off. 0: always allowed. Also needs multiplayer to be allowed and at least one White Sign Limit (for white signs) or Red Sign Limit (for red signs) flag to be set.
